title: On the Challenges of Using Black-Box APIs for Toxicity Evaluation in Research
reasoning: The paper extensively discusses the evaluation and reproducibility of toxicity detection in language models, which is inherently an ethical concern related to the safety and responsible deployment of AI. It addresses the impact of API changes on 'rigorous assessment of model risk' and 'research reproducibility,' and also mentions 'psychological well-being' of annotators exposed to toxic content. The recommendations section further outlines practices for ethical and reliable evaluation over time.
